notes.title: Companions Update
notes.notes:
Hi Explorers,

This update is initially rolled out on the Closed Beta Branch and will later move to the Prologue Branch.

After months of hard work, I'm happy to share the new update that brings companions—a highly requested feature from the community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806868/9b3fbfe8e0627e7f5e73143c586f83657110a138.jpg[/img]
We are here traveling with some recently hired companions.


Companions are people or creatures that you can hire throughout the galaxy on planets or in bars, spending your hard-earned cash or resources. Different species will require different items. They can be Antz, Feral Dogs, Bugs, Zetons, Pirates, or Robotikos.
These companions will follow you wherever you go and will assist you in battles on planets, caves, space stations, and even on freighters in space. Make sure to give them medkits when they’re injured, as they may die. You can also send them back to your ship if you think they won’t make it.
They have stats that can be leveled up as they kill enemies.
I'm looking forward to expanding on this feature with your ideas.

[previewyoutube=t0rQi56cinU;full][/previewyoutube]

This update brings many improvements:

   [list]
[*]  Fixed an issue when selling houses from your ship
[*]     Art: Improved animation for planet walls
[*]     Leaders in settlements on planets will now say something before attacking you
[*]     Fixed wood not being sellable
[*]     Improved electricity mechanics with sounds and animations
[*]     Space stations now have statues as well
[*]     Fixed a reported issue when talking to Hank
[*]     Art: Dynamic shadows are now smaller when running around the planet
[*]     You can now see if a planet has been visited from space
[*]     You can now zoom in and out on planets from the pause menu
[*]     Increased shooting speed in space
[*]     QOL: You can now see your current galaxy in the galaxy panel
[*]     QOL: Eating a consumable in the pause menu will keep the cursor on it
[/list]
Thank you for playing and supporting the game with your valuable feedback and wishlists.

Jorge

notes.title: Paving the way to the Companions update
notes.notes:
Hi, travelers!

I have been working full-on the new highly requested feature that I can't wait to share with you: Companions. It's a complex mechanic, ensuring it integrates smoothly with the game's complexity. In the meantime, here are some important fixes I’ve been working on. I’m really happy about the performance improvements on planets with a lot of content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806868/7ec2fdb6cc259cdc9fa201c43a6749078cb986dd.jpg[/img]
Features:

[list]
[*]     Can now concatenate dashes with a window of 0.2 seconds.
[*]     Coop player can now interact with objects.
[*]     Saving now uses JSON format for easier modding.
[*]     Increased player bullet speed (based on feedback).

[/list]

notes.title: Prologue Update 19:
notes.notes:
Hi travelers,


Here are the main improvements I've made to ATTS in the new update:

   [list]
[*]  Hoverbikes now have lanterns to help you see better at night.
[*]     I've brought back a really cool feature: stealing ships. When you encounter an enemy in space, you can steal their ship or, in some cases, tow it to sell it for scraps.
[*]     Dynamic lighting is now working, creating a nice atmosphere with lights at night.
[*]     Melee combat has been enhanced with combos. This was a feature that was requested by many playtesters, making combat more dynamic.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806868/b282eba0522a4debb2cd20d9701c5b74edfd3762.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806868/b282eba0522a4debb2cd20d9701c5b74edfd3762.gif[/img][/url]

[*]     Enemies now have hurt animations, giving a bit of a breather when fighting them.
[*]     Improved performance by applying a pooling system for bullets on planets.
[*]     You can now find and set up campfires and beds on planets to rest and 
[*]     Added indicators on the map for ships, hoverbikes, and ship parts to help with planet exploration.
[*]     Fixed a bug where planet teleports weren't spawning in pairs.
[*]     Added safe areas around campfires and planet cities where no enemies will spawn.
[/list]

Be safe out there
Jorge

notes.title: HotFix
notes.notes:
[h1]Hotfix Improvements:[/h1]

1. [b]Enemy Balance Adjustments:[/b] Refined the enemy balancing to provide a more engaging and fair gameplay experience.

2. [b]Resolved Boss Navigation Issue:[/b] Fixed the problem where the boss character was not actively pursuing the player. The boss now behaves as intended, increasing the challenge and intensity of encounters.

3. [b]Enhanced Fog of War:[/b] Improved the functionality of the fog of war system to include the player's position, allowing for better strategic decision-making and navigation.

4. [b]Fixed Sound Problems:[/b] Addressed the issues related to sound not being properly applied in certain situations, ensuring a more immersive audio experience for players.

5. [b]Expanded Housing Options:[/b] Added additional beds to houses throughout the game world, providing players with more resting places and enhancing the realism of the environment.

6. [b]Increased Ship Shooting Rate:[/b] Boosted the shooting rate for ships, making space combat more dynamic and action-packed.

7. [b]Resolved Saving Issues:[/b] Identified and fixed several problems related to saving progress, ensuring that player data is now reliably and accurately saved.

8. [b]Enhanced Emergent Gameplay:[/b] Implemented changes that facilitate emergent gameplay opportunities, allowing players to discover new and unexpected experiences within the game world.

These improvements address various gameplay aspects, enhancing balance, functionality, immersion, and overall player satisfaction. We are committed to delivering the best possible experience and appreciate your support as we continue to refine and optimize the game.
